abort.single_instance_allowed: Solar view is already set up.

user.title: Solar view
user.description: Where the panels are, and what can hold their production back. Production and export come from the Energy settings.

data_description.export_limit_kw: 0 when nothing may go to the grid, empty when there is no limit.
0 when nothing may go to the grid, empty when there is no limit.
data_description.weather_model: An Open-Meteo model name. ecmwf_aifs025_single covers 16 days and fills the days a shorter model lacks.

error.bad_model: Open-Meteo does not know this model. Check its spelling against Open-Meteo's model list.

no_weather.title: Solar view: no new weather since {since}
no_weather.description: Open-Meteo has not answered for 12 hours, so the sun forecast is paused. It starts again by itself once Open-Meteo answers.

not_picked.title: Solar view: pick it as the solar forecast
not_picked.description: In Settings > Dashboards > Energy, set the solar panels' forecast to Solar view alone. Another forecast beside it counts the sun twice; without it, the Energy dashboard and the Solar view page read the other forecast.

set_month_prices.name: Set month prices
set_month_prices.description: Stores a finished month's bill prices, so Solar view counts that month at them. Prices are all-in per kWh, excise and VAT included. Give the month alone to remove it.

f1.name: F1 price
f1.description: All-in price per kWh in band F1, or the one price of a single-price contract.

f2.name: F2 price
f2.description: All-in price per kWh in band F2, with F1 and F3.

f3.name: F3 price
f3.description: All-in price per kWh in band F3, with F1 and F2.

f23.name: F23 price
f23.description: All-in price per kWh in band F23, with F1, for a two-band contract.

fixed.name: Fixed part
fixed.description: The month's fixed part, VAT included. Below 0 when a bonus outweighs it.
